intro: Here's the premise: gemini api free tier limits should cost nothing to get started. Between open-source projects, free API tiers and self-hostable tools, it can. Below is the working setup we actually use, plus the gotchas we hit.

We'll walk through Gemini API Free Tier, Openrouter Free Models, Groq Free Tier, and Measure before you optimize — and finish with the questions people actually ask, so you can check before you buy anything. You shouldn't have to buy anything.

sections.heading: Gemini API Free Tier
paragraphs: First, the thing that actually matters: Google's Gemini API has a free tier with per-minute and per-day model quotas — no credit card required.

In practice that means: You sign in with a Google account, create a key in AI Studio, and call the models over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The free tier's rate limits are more than enough for a blog that writes a few posts a day, and the paid tier is only for when you outgrow the quotas.
No signup wall, no credit card — just a README and some patience.
bullets: Create a Google AI Studio API key
Point any OpenAI-compatible client at the Gemini OpenAI endpoint
Set LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY and LLM_MODEL and this engine writes with it

sections.heading: Openrouter Free Models
paragraphs: Worth spending ten minutes on: OpenRouter aggregates dozens of model providers behind one API, and a set of models carry a ':free' suffix with no credit card required.

In practice that means: One key, one endpoint, many backends — you can switch models in a config line and keep the same code. The free models rotate, but the pattern is stable: check the model list, pick the ones marked free, done.
For a personal project or side business, this covers you without breaking a sweat.

sections.heading: Groq Free Tier
paragraphs: The foundation looks like this: Groq offers a free tier for open-weight LLMs with some of the fastest inference speeds anywhere.

Concretely: Llama-family models run on dedicated hardware that makes response times almost embarrassing, and the free tier has enough tokens for a daily content job. It plugs into this engine through the same OpenAI-compatible interface as every other provider.
For a personal project or side business, this covers you without breaking a sweat.
